verdict.rationale: Claude is accessed only through hosted APIs. The only weights-related evidence is the Transparency hub's statement that Anthropic protects its model weights, which implies closed weights but does not explicitly tell users that weights cannot be downloaded. That makes the honesty branch of the story only glancingly met. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that weights are closed or unavailable for download, any stated weights license or self-hosting policy, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can download the model weights under a stated license and run them myself — or the platform is honest that weights are closed

citations.quote: It also covers how we protect model weights and respond to safety incidents.
